chill.name: Off Sausalito / Richardson Bay
chill.good: Your favorite. Sunny, and the hills block the wind.
chill.watch: It's shallow, so keep an eye on the depth gauge. Stay clear of the ferry route into Sausalito and the boats anchored there.

chill.name: East side of Angel Island
chill.good: The island blocks the west wind. Quieter than Ayala Cove. Probably close to your captain's spot.
chill.watch: Avoid Raccoon Strait on the north side, where the current is strong.
chill.extra: Quarry Beach is the classic lunch anchor here: mud bottom, good holding. Arrive before about 12:30, and note the bottom drops off steeply to the east.

chill.name: Clipper Cove, Treasure Island
chill.good: Sheltered on three sides, flat water, Bay Bridge views. Good for longer hangs.
chill.watch: Far from Sausalito. Shallow entrance with a shoal on the north side, so enter near high tide.
chill.extra: 12–18 ft, mud/sand bottom. No permit needed for a stay under 24 hours. Busy raft-ups on weekends.

chill.name: Ayala Cove moorings, Angel Island
chill.good: Well protected from wind and swell, with the Bay's biggest public docks and moorings, plus a café and trails ashore.
chill.watch: Busy on summer weekends. Day slips are 8 am to sunset (fee). Reach it through Raccoon Strait, so mind the current.

chill.name: McCovey Cove (game days)
chill.good: Right next to Pier 40. Float behind right field and wait for a splash hit.
chill.watch: No wake. Anchor no more than 2 hours before first pitch, and no overnight stays. Crowded with kayaks.

chill.name: Belvedere Cove
chill.good: A pretty lunch or sunset spot between Belvedere and Tiburon, next door to Sam's.

chill.name: Aquatic Park cove
chill.good: Inside the breakwater, the most protected water on the SF city front.
chill.watch: Swimmers. Anchoring needs a National Park Service permit, and it's strictly dead slow. Check the NPS rules first.

docks.name: Fish
docks.how: Tie up at Clipper Yacht Harbor's south dock (Basin 2) for lunch at Fish.

docks.name: Clipper Yacht Harbor
docks.how: The big one: Sausalito's largest harbor, 700 slips in 4 basins. Guest and transient slips; call ahead.

docks.name: Le Garage
docks.how: French bistro in an old auto shop. Tie up on Schoonmaker Point Marina's north dock.

docks.name: Schoonmaker Point Marina
docks.how: Guest slips by prior arrangement; side-ties for big boats.

docks.name: Horizons
docks.how: Its own 84-ft dock for diners, downtown on Bridgeway. Reserve ahead. Expect ferry wakes here.

docks.name: Sausalito Yacht Harbor
docks.how: Downtown marina, steps from the shops and restaurants. Call about guest slips.

docks.name: Sam's Anchor Cafe
docks.how: Docks below the deck, room for about a dozen boats; they'll serve you aboard. Shallow at low tide, so go mid to high tide.

docks.name: Ayala Cove docks
docks.how: State park day slips, 8 am to sunset (fee, self-pay), plus moorings. Café, picnic areas, Mt. Livermore hike.

docks.name: South Beach Harbor (home)
docks.how: Your harbor. It also has guest docks if friends come by boat.

docks.name: The Ramp
docks.how: Casual waterfront spot in Mission Bay, just a mile south of Pier 40. Guest dock, first come, first served.

docks.name: Pier 39 Marina
docks.how: Guest slips in the middle of Fisherman's Wharf. Touristy, but handy. Watch for ferries at Pier 41 next door.

docks.name: San Francisco Marina
docks.how: West Harbor guest docks (charged per foot), by the Marina Green and Chestnut St. There's a gas dock here too.

docks.name: Treasure Isle Marina
docks.how: Marina inside Clipper Cove. Call about guest berths. (Pin approximate.)

docks.name: Jack London Square guest docks
docks.how: Free, first come, first served, right by the restaurants and Heinold's First and Last Chance Saloon.

docks.name: Pasta Pelican
docks.how: On the Alameda side of the estuary. Free tie-up when you eat there.

docks.name: Ballena Isle Marina
docks.how: Alameda marina with a fuel dock, pumpout, and restaurants.

docks.name: Emeryville Marina + Trader Vic's
docks.how: Trader Vic's sits next to the marina. Call the marina about tying up.

docks.name: Berkeley Marina
docks.how: Guest slips by the day, a fuel dock, and a launch ramp.
